ANALOGUE.description: Pin is set as analog input

BEVEL_WIDTH.description: Set Button Bevel Width, 0 pixel to 15 pixels.

CHECKUPDATE_INVALIDFILE.description: The specified file is not valid '4xe' or '4fn'

CHECKUPDATE_NEWFILE.description: The specified file is newer than the file running in Flash

CHECKUPDATE_NOFILE.description: The specified file does not exist

CHECKUPDATE_OLDFILE.description: The specified file is equal to or older than the file running in Flash

CHECKUPDATE_QUERY.description: Checks the specified file and compares its DateTime to the program running in Flash

CHECKUPDATE_UPDATEALWAYS.description: Always updates the program in Flash

CHECKUPDATE_UPDATEDONE.description: An update was performed, and the program is running from RAM

CHECKUPDATE_UPDATENEWER.description: Updates the program in Flash if the program on uSD is newer

CLIPPING.description: Turns clipping on/offThe clipping points are set with gfx_ClipWindow and must be set first.

CONTRAST.description: Set contrast value, 0 = display off, 1-15 = contrast level

FE_DIR_FULL.description: All root dir entry are taken

FE_FAT_EOF.description: Fat attempt to read beyond EOF

FE_FILE_NOT_FOUND.description: File not found in open for read

FE_FILE_OVERWRITE.description: A file with same name exist already

FE_MALLOC_FAILED.description: Malloc could not allocate the FILE struct

FE_MEDIA_FULL.description: All clusters in partition are taken

FONT_ID.description: Set the required font. See font table Note: The value could be the name of a custom font included in a users program in a data statement.
FONT_ID.value: 1 to 11 or (FONT_1 to FONT_11) Default = FONT_3

FRAME_DELAY.description: Set the inter frame delay for media_Video(...)

GFX_BUTTON_BACKGROUND.description: store default button colour for hilite line tracker

GFX_BUTTON_FOREGROUND.description: store default text colour for hilite line tracker

GFX_CLIP_BOTTOM.description: current clip value (reads full size if clipping turned off)

GFX_CLIP_LEFT.description: current clip value (reads full size if clipping turned off)

GFX_CLIP_RIGHT.description: current clip value (reads full size if clipping turned off)

GFX_CLIP_TOP.description: current clip value (reads full size if clipping turned off)

GFX_HILITE_LINE.description: current multi line button hilite line

GFX_LAST_CHAR_HEIGHT.description: calculated height from last call to charHeight function

GFX_LAST_CHAR_WIDTH.description: calculated char width from last call to charWidth function

GFX_LAST_STR_HEIGHT.description: calculated height from last call to strHeight function

GFX_LAST_STR_WIDTH.description: calculated width from last call to strWidth function

GFX_LINE_COUNT.description: count of lines in multiline button

GFX_PIXEL_SHIFT.description: pixel shift for button depress illusion

GFX_THUMB_PERCENT.description: size of slider thumb as percentage

GFX_VECT_X1.description: gp rect, used by multiline button to hilite required line

GRAD_DOWN.description: gradient changes in the vertical direction

GRAD_LEFT.description: gradient changes in the horizontal direction

GRAD_RIGHT.description: gradient changes in the horizontal direction

GRAD_UP.description: gradient changes in the vertical direction

GRAD_WAVE_HOR.description: gradient wave in the horizontal direction

GRAD_WAVE_VER.description: gradient wave in the vertical direction

GRAM_PIXEL_COUNT_HI.description: HI word of count of pixels in the set GRAM area

GRAM_PIXEL_COUNT_LO.description: LO word of count of pixels in the set GRAM area

IMAGE_CLUSTER.description: Specifies the image start cluster pos (for FAT16 only)

IMAGE_SECTOR.description: Specifies the image start sector in cluster pos (for FAT16 only)

IMG_FLAGS.description: bit 4 determines colour mode, other bits reserved

IMG_FRAME_COUNT.description: count of frames in a movie

IMG_FRAME_DELAY.description: if image, else inter frame delay for movie

IMG_PIXEL_COUNT_HI.description: count of pixels in the current frame

IMG_PIXEL_COUNT_LO.description: count of pixels in the current frame

INPUT.description: Pin is set to an input

I_STAYONTOP.description: draw on top of other images always

I_TOPMOST.description: draw on top of other images next update

I_TOUCH_DISABLE.description: set to disable touch for this image: 1 for movie or 0 for image

MEDIA_SECTOR_COUNT.description: uSD number of bytes remaining in sector

OBJECT_COLOUR.description: Generic colour for gfx_LineTo, gfx_LineRel, gfx_Dot, gfx_Bullet and gfx_BoxTo

OUTLINE_COLOUR.description: Outline colour for rectangles and circles(set to 0 for no effect)

OUTPUT.description: Pin is set to an output

PEN_SIZE.description: Set the draw mode for gfx_LineTo, gfx_LineRel, gfx_Dot, gfx_Bullet and gfx_BoxTo (default mode is OUTLINE)

SCREEN_MODE.value: 0 or LANDSCAPE1 or LANDSCAPE_R2 or PORTRAIT3 or PORTRAIT_R

SOUND.description: Pin is set as sound output

TEXT_ATTRIBUTES.description: Allows a combination of text attributes to be defined together by 'or'ing the bits together. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed. Example: txt_Set(TEXT_ATTRIBUTES, BOLD | INVERSE); // bold + inverse Note: bits 0-3 and 8-15 are reserved.
TEXT_ATTRIBUTES.value: 16 or BOLD 32 or ITALIC 64 or INVERSE 128 or UNDERLINED

TEXT_BOLD.description: Sets Bold Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_HEIGHT.description: Set the text height multiplier. Text will be printed magnified vertically by this factor.

TEXT_INVERSE.description: Sets Inverse Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_ITALIC.description: Sets Italic Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_MARGIN.description: text left pixel pos for carriage return

TEXT_OPACITY.description: Selects whether or not the 'background' pixels are drawn.

TEXT_PRINTDELAY.description: Set the delay between character printing to give a 'teletype' like effect.

TEXT_UNDERLINED.description: Sets Underlined Text mode for the next string or char. The feature automatically resets after printing using putstr or print has completed.

TEXT_WIDTH.description: Set the text width multiplier. Text will be printed magnified horizontally by this factor.

TEXT_WRAP.description: Sets the pixel position where text wrap will occur at RHS The feature automatically resets when screen mode is changed. If the value is set to 0, text wrap is turned off of the current screen. Note: The value is in pixel.

TEXT_XGAP.description: Set the pixel gap between characters. The gap is in pixel units.

TEXT_YGAP.description: Set the pixel gap between lines. The gap is in pixel units.

TOUCH_RAW_X.description: 12-bit raw A2D X value from touch screen

TOUCH_RAW_Y.description: 12-bit raw A2D Y value from touch screen

TRANSPARENCY.description: Turn the transparency ON or OFF. Transparency is automatically turned OFF after the next image or video command.

TRANSPARENT_COLOUR.description: Colour that needs to be made transparent.

TXT_FONT_MAX.description: max number of chars in font

TXT_FONT_TYPE.description: font type, 0 = system font, else pointer to user font

WIDGET_F_FLASH.description: set if this is a flash based widget.

WIDGET_F_INITIALISED.description: Flag when 'base gauge needle, etc.' is done

WIDGET_F_INPUT.description: Set if this is an input (Used only with the IDE).

WIDGET_F_INTERNAL.description: Internal use only (force redraw on next write).

WIDGET_F_TOUCH_ENABLE.description: Set to disable touch for this image, (default=1 for movie, 0 for image).

WIDGET_F_UNDRAW_ONLY.description: Set to prevent draw of new needle.

WIDGET_HI_WORD.description: Flash offset high word (Flash widgets only).

WIDGET_LO_WORD.description: Flash offset low word (External Flash widgets only).
